name: keyboard-features
title: Keyboard features
description: A keyboard-first product's shortcuts as cards: the keys, what they do, and a card that lights up when you press them.
docs: Pass title, description, shortcuts (six to nine, each with an id, keys, a verb-first title and a line of detail) and optionally cta, platform and preventDefault. Keys are written as text: Mod+K is a chord (Mod is Cmd on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere), G then P is a sequence, and ? or Esc are single keys; the modifiers are Mod, Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Meta. Press a real shortcut while no field has focus and its card lights for a second, its keys turn solid and its title is announced politely; in a sequence the first key lights and the second has a moment to follow. Under reduced motion the card gets a bold outline instead and nothing lifts, fades or flips. platform is auto by default, which reads the keyboard after hydration, so until then Mod is written Cmd/Ctrl and no reader is shown a key they do not have; mac and other fix it. Mac symbols come with their spoken names, so every key is also text. Keys are never taken from the browser unless preventDefault is set. The helpers that parse and match shortcuts live in keys.ts, which needs no client code. labels translates the fixed words.
